categories.main_business_segments: Ping An Insurance (Group) Company of China, Ltd. operates primarily in integrated finance, health and senior care services. Its core segments include life and health insurance, property and casualty insurance, banking, asset management, and finance enablement businesses. The Group also develops technology-enabled ecosystems supporting these sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), big data, and large domain-specific AI models to enhance underwriting, claims processing, customer service, and health management. It employs digital transformation strategies including online-to-offline (O2O) service models, smart voice agents, and AI-powered medical diagnosis systems. The Group also uses data-driven decision-making and risk management methodologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ping An serves over 240 million retail customers and more than 4 million corporate clients across China. Its customers include individuals seeking insurance, banking, wealth management, health and senior care services, as well as enterprises requiring employee health management and financial services. The Group targets middle-class families, small and micro-enterprises, and large state-owned and foreign-invested enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's primary market is mainland China, with extensive operations in over 330 cities nationwide. It also has overseas presence through subsidiaries and partnerships in Hong Kong and other countries, including a network of medical institutions in 35 countries. Key regional focuses include Guangdong, Beijing, Shandong, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ping An operates primarily as a midstream and downstream integrated financial services provider. It offers insurance underwriting, banking services, asset management, and health and senior care services, acting as both a payer and service integrator. The Group also manages proprietary medical institutions and technology platforms, positioning itself as a service ecosystem enabler.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus is on advancing its 'integrated finance + health and senior care' dual-driver strategy, emphasizing service differentiation and technology enablement. It invests heavily in R&D for AI, big data, and vertical large models in finance, health care, and senior care. The company prioritizes digital transformation, customer-centric innovation, and development of proprietary health and senior care ecosystems.
categories.revenue_model: Ping An generates revenue through insurance premium income (life, health, property and casualty), banking interest and fee income, asset management fees, and finance enablement services. It also earns from technology services, health and senior care memberships, and proprietary medical institutions. Revenue streams include product sales, service fees, commissions, investment income, and digital platform monetization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ping An is one of the world's leading integrated financial groups and ranks No.1 by brand value among global insurance groups. It holds leading market positions in China’s life insurance, property and casualty insurance, banking, and asset management sectors. The Group competes with major Chinese and international insurers, banks, and fintech companies, leveraging its integrated ecosystem and technology advantages for differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, Ping An reported total assets of RMB12.96 trillion and operating profit attributable to shareholders of RMB121.86 billion, representing 9.1% year-on-year growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB126.61 billion, up 47.8% year-on-year. The Group serves 242 million retail customers with steady growth in customer base, contracts per customer, and profit per customer. It maintains strong solvency ratios well above regulatory requirements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ping An emphasizes a customer-centric value proposition of 'worry-free, time-saving, and money-saving' services through integrated finance and health and senior care ecosystems. It differentiates by providing one-stop, multi-channel financial and health services enabled by AI and big data, professional financial advisers, family doctors, and senior care concierges. The Group integrates insurance with health and senior care services to offer comprehensive, cost-effective, and convenient solutions, supported by proprietary technology and extensive service networks.
